reason: Slow months hurt me and I need jobs coming in, so I would join since it is free and only costs me when I get paid. I still want to see the work before I trust it.
objection: How do I know real customers will come and how many jobs per month? A free sign-up means nothing to me until I see the request volume in Riyadh for my kind of work.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real verified requests in Riyadh for my service type over the last 30 days, with a clear count of how many would have come to my shop.
